purpose: Compose translation mounts, center-to-center distance joints, slack center-distance limits, world-axis translation locks, slack world-axis translation limits and fixed world-space direction locks around one shared donor-core integration step with bounded convergence-aware pre/post stabilization.

properties.constraints.directionLocks: bounded fixed world-space direction translation-lock array
properties.options: bounded pre/post family passes, per-family iteration counts and convergence tolerances

limitations: distance-limit and axis-limit range interiors remain intentionally slack
axis locks and axis limits use world-space x/y axes and are not full prismatic/slider joints
direction locks use one caller-selected fixed world-space direction, leave perpendicular translation free, do not rotate with bodies and are not full prismatic/slider joints
fixed deterministic family order introduces ordering bias
conflicting constraints are bounded by pass counts and are not claimed to converge globally
the shared activity-gate and collision-isolation wrappers now route all six families; direction-lock isolation remains component-wide rather than direct-edge-only
no angular inertia, rotating local anchors, hinge, full slider/prismatic, rotational weld, motor or gear semantics
post-core projection can move bodies after donor-core contact evidence was generated

proves: the six-family contract shares exactly one donor-core integration step
fixed-direction locks are appended after the prior five-family order without replacing earlier semantics
bounded family pass and iteration budgets include direction locks
fixed-direction projection is restored while perpendicular translation remains free
the reused fixed-direction primitive preserves its standalone projection-lock contract
axis locks retain their existing guarded activity and component-isolation behavior under the six-family composer
axis limits retain bounded residuals, slack range semantics, guarded activity and component isolation without a second donor-core step
direction locks participate in guarded activity and component isolation while preserving the one-donor-core-step contract

truth.basis: The composer names ordering bias, translation-only scope, slack-range semantics, contact-evidence timing, fixed-world direction semantics and component-wide isolation behavior.

agency.basis: Callers choose family data, fixed direction vectors, bounded budgets, activity state, isolation request and convergence tolerances explicitly.

continuity.basis: Direction locks are appended after the existing five-family order while the donor source and prior family semantics remain preserved.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The integration reuses the direction-lock primitive inside the bounded one-step composer and guarded wrappers rather than chaining standalone step wrappers and accidentally integrating physics twice.
